UserAccount.title: UserAccount
UserAccount.description: Cloud-saved player account, active username, remembered usernames, and friends lists synchronized across devices.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the account owner.

savedUsers.description: Up to 8 remembered display usernames for quick switching across devices.

reqIn.description: Up to 50 incoming friend request usernames (lowercase).

reqOut.description: Up to 50 outgoing friend request usernames (lowercase).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the cloud account was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the cloud account was last updated.

PublicProfile.title: PublicProfile
PublicProfile.description: Non-PII username reservation record mapping a lowercase username to its owning UID.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID that owns this username.

username.description: Display casing of the claimed username.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when this username claim was created or updated.

/users/{userId}.description: Owner-isolated cloud account storing username, remembered usernames, and friend lists.

/publicProfiles/{usernameLower}.description: Public username uniqueness registry without any PII fields.
